claim: The chain authenticates a larger share of received messages within the analysis deadline than the best fragmentation mode (paired differences with CI, per scheme).
The chain needs fewer bytes on air per authenticated message than the best fragmentation mode (relative paired difference).
The chain has a lower unconditional delay (unauthenticated messages censored at the analysis deadline) than the best fragmentation mode.
The chain authenticates >= 95% of received messages within the source-stated latency need (C-V2X 100 ms), lossless channel (best case).
The chain reaches the target share within the deadline with a smaller channel budget (bytes/s) than the best fragmentation mode.
No mode accepts a forged message or a stale replay under symbol/fragment injection (1-30% of slots), replay of old epochs, or a receiver clock offset within the configured sync bound.
A mode keeps >= 90% of its no-attack share at 10% injection (pollution resistance of decode-and-verify).
Receiver CPU under 10% injection stays within 2x the no-attack receiver CPU.
